font: <font file name; must equal the --font-file basename>
source_path: <optional path the adapter read; basename must match too>
sha256: <sha256 of the exact font bytes; custom_encoding_audit.py re-hashes --font-file and compares>

adapter.name: <project-local adapter>
adapter.input_sha256: <sha256 the adapter computed over the bytes it parsed; must equal sha256>
adapter.inventory_method: <how records were extracted, e.g. parsed TRectNew + decoded DXT5 page>

native_encoding.name: <Python single-byte codec the original font was built for, e.g. cp1252>
native_encoding.resolver: <how an id becomes a character, e.g. id decoded as a cp1252 byte>
